data.name: Shattersight
data.detailed_description:
Shattersight is a fast-paced online arcade first-person shooter built around responsive movement and straightforward multiplayer action. Slide through firefights, dash out of danger, double jump across the battlefield, and wall run to approach enemies from unexpected angles.

Combine advanced movement with your weapons and killstreak rewards to keep the action moving. Shattersight is designed for players who want to jump into a match quickly and enjoy an energetic arcade-shooter experience.

Shattersight currently includes two multiplayer modes:

Team Deathmatch – Work with your team, win firefights, and reach the score limit before your opponents.

Capture the Flag – Steal the opposing team’s flag while defending your own.

Core features include fast-paced online combat, sliding, dashing, double jumping, wall running, killstreak rewards, connection-focused matchmaking, and team balancing at the beginning of each match.

Additional modes are planned for future development. A ranked mode is also planned once the player population is large enough to support healthy and competitive matchmaking.

Shattersight is being created by a solo developer with a focus on proactive updates and player feedback. Community polls, gameplay feedback, and match data will help guide balancing decisions, quality-of-life improvements, and the direction of future content.

My goal is to create a welcoming place where FPS players can enjoy quick matches, expressive movement, and satisfying arcade combat.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
